jobs.title: xunkao
jobs.prompt: Paint a brand-new chest-up character portrait in exactly the 3D render quality, materials and lighting of image 1, but not its place: a plain dark smoky blue-grey studio backdrop, head and shoulders filling the upper half of the frame, cropped at the chest, the face large and sharp, looking toward the camera. He is the only person in the frame. Style: high-end Chinese 3D donghua CG, Unreal Engine 5 cinematic character render with visible skin pores, fine wrinkles, individually rendered hair strands, heavy layered cloth with wear; cool desaturated grey-blue palette, strong rim light; realistic human proportions and a normal-sized nose and eyes. Not a photograph, not a cartoon. Clean image with nothing written anywhere. The man: East Asian man of forty-five, stocky and thick-necked with broad heavy shoulders, a wide square face with a heavy jaw, clean-shaven with short dark stubble shadow, a broad flat nose, small hard eyes under thick straight black brows, a stern scowl, a plain dark charcoal-grey Song-dynasty round-collared official robe (yuanlingpao) whose round neckline closes at the right shoulder with a white inner collar showing at the throat, smooth chest with no buttons, no frogs and no stand collar, a soft black gauze futou cap with two short soft ribbons hanging at the back of his head, holding a plain wooden tally board against his chest.
